author_reading_scope: Inspected the complete relevant arguments and definitions in Schiffmann §§1.1–1.3 and 2.1–2.4 from the full local PDF/TXT artifact. Inspected Young §2.1 from the complete arXiv:1810.08238v2 PDF after the MPIM mirror timed out through its initial attempt and five recovery retries. The MPIM URL is retained as dropped mirror history; the accessible arXiv PDF is the cited alternative. Every accepted Hall multiplication, finiteness and associativity claim has a full local proof; sources guide and corroborate the statements only.

sources.title: Olivier Schiffmann, Lectures on Hall Algebras, arXiv:math/0611617v2

author_read_locators.locator: §1.1, PDF pp. 6–7: small finitary abelian categories and finite Hom/Ext¹
author_read_locators.detail: The source's finitary field-linear examples are not imported; the local definition accepts an arbitrary commutative coefficient ring and explicitly uses Yoneda classes.

author_read_locators.locator: §1.3, PDF pp. 7–9: Hall multiplication, exact-sequence normalization, finite support, unit and two-step flag associativity
author_read_locators.detail: The source uses a square-root Euler twist and endpoint-labelled sequence counts. This batch fixes the untwisted subobject convention and proves the flag count without dividing by automorphism orders.

author_read_locators.locator: §2.1, PDF pp. 22–23: Jordan quiver, nilpotent representations and partition indexing
author_read_locators.detail: The local classification argument uses the existing nilpotent Jordan-string and rank-uniqueness proofs.

author_read_locators.locator: §2.2, PDF pp. 23–25: finite-field Hall numbers and the simple Jordan-quiver square
author_read_locators.detail: The finite examples are checked directly from local subobject counts; the general Hall-polynomial argument is reconstructed locally.

author_read_locators.locator: §2.3–2.4, PDF pp. 25–30: universal Hall polynomials and the normalized generic algebra map to symmetric functions
author_read_locators.detail: The local theorem proves the structure polynomials, triangular polynomial basis and generator normalization.

author_read_locators.locator: §2.4, PDF p. 29–30: further partition-basis/Hall–Littlewood and transported-pairing identification
author_read_locators.detail: The full local proof of this stronger basis/pairing identification is not supplied here; no current item or consumer uses it. The gap and proposed A-page placement are in the batch notes.
